reply_text:
I can't set up the recurring 07:45 brief. I have no way to schedule a Slack post that will run on its own. The cron option in my toolset only runs locally and doesn't post back into Slack, so it wouldn't reliably reach #strategic-random.

I posted two replies in #strategic-random's thread. The first overstated my limits, so the second corrects it.

What I can do is post a brief whenever someone asks. Before posting, I'll check who is in each source channel. #strategic-pod and #inc-vtg-hartford have different members than #strategic-random, so I'll only include content that everyone in the destination can already see. Finance figures stay out unless the audience is entitled to them.

To get a daily 07:45 post, the workspace integrations owner would need to set up the scheduling.
